dialogues.speaker: Ajaw
dialogues.text: This challenge looks like it'd suit you right to the ground, Kinich... Wanna try it together?

dialogues.speaker: Kinich
dialogues.text: I know full well that you're planning to kick me in the back the moment I jump.

dialogues.speaker: Kinich
dialogues.text: I bet you're also thinking about pulling out a plank or two so I end up plummeting to my early demise... Hmm?

dialogues.speaker: Kinich
dialogues.text: You already tried that over at the Scions of the Canopy, remember? You should know better than to think I'd fall for that one twice.

dialogues.speaker: Ajaw
dialogues.text: Curse you and your stupid vigilance! Who else acts like that on vacation!? Absolutely insufferable!
